title: Diabetes mellitus: type, complications and medication status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, its complications and related long-term drug use.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for management of type 1 diabetes and CKD stage 4.

HPI
The patient is a 36-year-old woman presenting for a routine follow-up. She has a long-term history of type 1 diabetes mellitus. She reports that she has been managing her condition with insulin and denies any recent acute issues. She also has a known diagnosis of chronic kidney disease stage 4. She reports feeling generally well and notes that her energy levels have been stable. She denies any recent changes in her renal function symptoms or significant fluctuations in her blood glucose levels.

Medication List
- Insulin (long-term)
- Vitamin D supplement

Exam
The patient appears well-nourished and in no acute distress. She is alert and oriented to person, place, and time. Skin is intact without lesions. Heart rate is 72 bpm, blood pressure is 118/76 mmHg. Respiratory effort is normal.

Assessment
1. Type 1 diabetes mellitus
2. Chronic kidney disease stage 4

Plan
Continue current insulin regimen. Monitor renal function with upcoming lab work. Follow up in three months.

Electronically signed, L. Moreau, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: CKD is listed under 'with' for diabetes, so the link is presumed: use the combination code E10.22.
Code also the CKD stage (N18.4) as instructed at the diabetes CKD code or separately when unrelated.
Do not assign Z79.4 for type 1 diabetes; insulin use is inherent.

distractors.why: 'With' presumes the link without 'due to' wording.
The stage of CKD must be reported with N18.-.
Z79.4 is not assigned for type 1 diabetes.
